name: Document Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies a type of financial or commercial document.

RADM.name: Remittance Advice Message
RADM.definition: Document is a remittance advice sent separately from the current transaction.

RPIN.name: Related Payment Instruction
RPIN.definition: Document is a linked payment instruction to which the current payment instruction is related, for example, in a cover scenario.

FXDR.name: Foreign Exchange Deal Reference
FXDR.definition: Document is a pre-agreed or pre-arranged foreign exchange transaction to which the payment transaction refers.

SCOR.name: Structured Communication Reference
SCOR.definition: Document is a structured communication reference provided by the creditor to identify the referred transaction.
